name: OpenStreetMap Overpass
purpose: Near-me rooftops: dealers, parts, repair, tires, fuel, wash, inspection, towing
auth: none — identify the app with User-Agent
cost: Free public instances. Soft cap ~10k queries / 1 GB per day.
notes: Primary directory source. Hourly cache. Timeout falls back to 90210 / 43215 samples only when those ZIPs were asked.

name: Nominatim
purpose: Geocode ZIP or city to lat/lon
cost: Free public API. Max 1 req/s. Cache repeats.

name: NHTSA vPIC
purpose: VIN decode — year, make, model, engine
notes: Already live in @/lib/nhtsa. Directory imports; does not edit that file.

name: NHTSA SaferCar (api.nhtsa.gov)
notes: Complaints + ratings fetch live in src/lib/directory. Recalls stay in @/lib/nhtsa.

name: EPA FuelEconomy.gov
notes: Menu walk year → make → model → options → /vehicle/{id}. Directory also links fueleconomy.gov/feg/bymodel/{year}_{Make}_{Model}.shtml.

name: IIHS ratings
purpose: Crash-test ratings by year / make / model — link-out only

name: Google Places
cost: Paid after free trial credit. Nearby Search billed per request.
notes: Live Nearby Search when the key is on (configured:true, probed:skip). Off → connected:false, results:[]. No scrape of Maps HTML.

name: Yelp Fusion
notes: Live Fusion merge when the key is on (configured:true, probed:skip). Off → empty, no invented stars.

name: YouTube Data API
purpose: Shop walk-around and how-to video search
notes: search.list when the key is on (configured:true, probed:skip). Off → videos:[], search URL still works. No scrape.

name: eBay Motors / Browse API
auth: OAuth client credentials — a secret is required
cost: Free developer app, then call limits.
notes: Browse API needs a secret, so we ship outbound search URLs only.

name: MarketCheck
purpose: Dealer inventory, private-party listings, market price
cost: Free eval (~500 calls) then per-call + monthly.
notes: Plate decoder live when the key is on (configured:true, probed:skip). Listings not called. No fake in-stock tiles.

name: CarAPI
notes: Catalog only. NHTSA vPIC already covers VIN identity.

name: CarsXE
notes: Plate decoder live when the key is on (configured:true, probed:skip). Dark without the key. VIN path stays NHTSA.

name: Auto.dev
notes: Stub. We do not scrape dealer sites.

name: VinAudit
notes: Weekend key. configured:true when present. Title snapshot on /history names VinAudit. Never a dummy Carfax.

name: Chrome Data (J.D. Power)
purpose: OEM build data, style IDs, residual values
notes: Not a public API. Cataloged so we do not pretend.

name: TecDoc / TecAlliance
notes: Do not fake TecDoc SKUs. Parts desk is outbound search URLs.

name: MOTOR / Identifix (Hearst Aftermarket)
purpose: Labor times, diagnostics, TSBs for shops
cost: Paid. Not a consumer free API.
notes: Cataloged as Aftermarket / Identifix. Hours stay heuristic until licensed.
